summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC web API, which powers real-time communication like video calls, have introduced enhancements to how connection statistics and error handling are managed. The state of ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) will now start in a "new" state, providing clearer insights into the connection's progress, while the DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) role will be initially set to "unknown" until a negotiation occurs. These changes ultimately aim to improve the reliability and transparency of WebRTC connections, making it easier for developers to diagnose issues and ensure smoother communication experiences **without sacrificing security**.
